decisions.decision: Use mountain-soldier-seed12202 (Recommended): conical blackened helmet with a riveted brow band and nasal, large grey fur collar, rounded blackened pauldrons, dark mail sleeves under a sleeveless off-white surcoat (dye field), black vambraces and gloves, fur cuffs: the cleanest silhouette and the clearest value split. Limitations: no fur ring on the helmet; reddened cheeks; low shoes under the fur cuffs; figure fills 93% of the height.

conditions: A rear-view concept is generated locally (Qwen Image Edit Plus 2511 in WanGP, Scene mode), painted over an orthographic back render of the approved mesh with the approved front concept as identity reference; two candidates; selection delegated.
The selected rear view is projected onto back-visible texels only, occlusion-tested and blended at the sides; the front keeps the TRELLIS texture from the approved concept.
Cook: decimate to the 12k troop budget with baked normals and 1024 maps; keep the pale wool as the faction dye field; the axe, round shield, bow, quiver and hammer are separate Blender items.
